name: customcard-website-asset-generation-v1
createdFor: website refresh, theme inventory, and marketing material
globalNegativePrompt: readable text, letters, words, numbers, fake calligraphy, pseudo-handwriting, signature, logo, watermark, QR code, barcode, caption plaque, text box, brand mark, product label, dense wallpaper, low contrast text-safe zone, generic greeting card clipart, people, faces, hands, cropped bodies, distorted anatomy
globalCardArtRules: Card background art must be text-free. CustomCard overlays exact copy later.
Keep a clean text-safe area and generous margins.
Use portrait 5:7 composition for card backgrounds.
Avoid competitor references and brand marks.
Prefer one specific remembered object over repeating broad occasion symbols.

customArtCardContract.purpose: A great CustomCard asset must feel like it came from a relationship, not an occasion aisle.
promptRules: Every custom art card prompt must include the recipient relationship, remembered object, emotional job, art move, and forbidden cliches.
The remembered object should be visually primary; the occasion symbol should be secondary or absent.
Do not generate raster text; all readable copy is rendered later by CustomCard.
Leave a deliberate proof-safe copy zone with enough contrast for app-rendered text.
Avoid greeting-card aisle shorthand unless it is grounded in the specific memory.
Prefer tactile art direction: paper cuts, letterpress, editorial still life, risograph, gouache, ink wash, collage, or photographed stationery materials.

gradingRubric.name: specificity
gradingRubric.pass: A viewer can name the relationship detail without reading the label.

gradingRubric.name: emotional fit
gradingRubric.pass: The asset supports the message's job: comfort, repair, pride, gratitude, or celebration.

gradingRubric.name: print usability
gradingRubric.pass: The center or chosen copy zone remains calm, high contrast, and margin-safe.

gradingRubric.name: anti-generic check
gradingRubric.pass: The card would be worse if reduced to balloons, hearts, caps, rings, stars, or florals alone.

assets.prompt: Photoreal editorial product shot for a landing page hero: one premium folded 5x7 greeting card standing on warm ivory paper beside a matching terracotta envelope. The visible card front has a clean app-rendered proof area with tasteful abstract botanical/ribbon artwork and blank space where CustomCard text can be composited later. Warm natural window light, visible paper grain, calm modern stationery desk, refined but not beige-only, subtle sage and terracotta accents, horizontal 16:10 composition with usable negative space on the left. No readable text, no logos, no hands, no clutter, no brand marks, no watermark.
assets.notes: Use for homepage hero after compositing deterministic card text or pairing with a rendered proof overlay.

artCardRules: Generate a portrait 5:7 custom art card background, not a finished raster-text card.
Make the remembered object visually primary and emotionally plausible.
Keep the copy zone clean enough for deterministic app-rendered text.
No people, faces, hands, readable text, logos, or brand marks.
Do not use generic occasion symbols unless the asset contract names why that symbol belongs.
